# WebP decoding fixtures

These three fixtures are copied unchanged from `golang.org/x/image@v0.24.0/testdata`.
They exercise VP8 lossy, VP8L lossless, and VP8X alpha decoding. See the accompanying
Go Authors BSD license.

Source: https://cs.opensource.google/go/x/image/+/refs/tags/v0.24.0:testdata/
